Activity.description: A daily USD series ending at the last complete day (VAL-6).

change_7d_bp.description:
The 7-day total against the previous 7 days, in basis points
(1 % = 100). None when either window has a missing or
implausible day (see `gap_days`) or the earlier total is zero.

days.description: Up to 30 complete days, oldest first.

gap_days.description:
Days in the two comparison windows that are absent or below 5 %
of the series median, treated as missing (methodology v0.3, D5).

Address.description:
An on-chain address in its chain's canonical text form (base58 on Solana,
0x-hex on EVM). Format checks belong to the registry and collectors.

controller.description:
The key in `field`, resolved to its effective controller. `Immutable`
means the field holds no key (renounced).

AdminPower.description: What an admin key can do outside an upgrade.

AssetGroups.description: TVL by asset group in whole US dollars; the four groups sum to the TVL.

Chain.description: The chain an address or fact lives on.

CodeTransparency.description: Does the deployed binary match public source? (OtterSec, COL-13)

warning.description: Set when the verified repo is outside the registry's GitHub org (COL-13).

commit.description: Full 40-character commit, when the registry records one.

oneOf.description: Controllers Celebtir cannot read or does not support yet.

Effective delay of zero: no time lock, or one a config authority
bypasses (v0.3; before v0.3 also any delay below the bar).
v0.3 (D4 option B): a delay above zero but below the delayed bar.

Controller.description: Who can change something, resolved to its effective controller.

oneOf.description: A registry-declared PDA re-derived from its program and typed seeds.

nested_signers.description:
Signers that are not plain wallet keys (another multisig's vault,
or an unknown program-derived address), resolved; each still
counts as one voter (edge case 5).

signers.description: Keys of the members with the Vote permission, sorted (UI-20).

admin.description:
A `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` holder other than the timelock itself: it
can change roles and the delay without waiting (ADR 024 D4).

oneOf.description: A multisig that can never reach its threshold (ADR 004).

An off-curve address (no private key can exist for it) whose
controlling program is not resolved by a verified registry
declaration. Never a key, never "unrecognized" (methodology v0.3).

owner_program.description: Owner of the account at that address; None when no account exists.

Dependencies.description: Direct callees of the core programs, from a transaction sample (COL-14).

declared.description:
True when the list comes from the registry instead of a
transaction sample (HyperEVM in wave 2, HCOL-10).

stale.description:
True when the latest window had no transactions and this list is
carried over from an earlier run; its evidence keeps the old slot.

Deprecation.description: Set on every v1 file once /v2/ exists; v1 then stays for 90 days (API-2).

successor.description: Path of the replacing version, e.g. `/data/v2/`.

sunset_date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`: the last day this version is published.

Evidence.description:
Where a fact came from: the account read, the slot it was read at, the
field that held the value, and a link anyone can open to check it.

Fact.description:
A value together with the evidence it was derived from. The evidence list
is never empty (SNAP-1): construction and deserialization both reject it.

Fact2.description:
A value together with the evidence it was derived from. The evidence list
is never empty (SNAP-1): construction and deserialization both reject it.

Fact3.description:
A value together with the evidence it was derived from. The evidence list
is never empty (SNAP-1): construction and deserialization both reject it.

Fact4.description:
A value together with the evidence it was derived from. The evidence list
is never empty (SNAP-1): construction and deserialization both reject it.

Fact5.description:
A value together with the evidence it was derived from. The evidence list
is never empty (SNAP-1): construction and deserialization both reject it.

Factor.description: The six factors, in PRD order.

next_step.description: What would raise the rating one level (SCO-5).

registry_sources.description:
Registry source pages behind a reviewed-none finding, which has no
on-chain read to cite (v0.3).

methodology_version.description: Charts mark the boundary where this changes (edge case 18).

attribution.description: How to credit the data when reusing it.

Metric.description:
A number from an external source, or why it is missing. Missing numbers
show as "data unavailable" and never fail a run (VAL-7).

NodeRating.description: One graph node's rating, for its colour and label (UI-21).

bounds_primary.description:
The protocol rejects a primary price outside a threshold of this
feed, per the registry's source (v0.3 guarded-primary rule).

guarded_by.description:
For a primary: the oracle networks its publisher documents as
bounding it. Each must be registered as a bounding fallback before the
guard counts (v0.3, D3); a documented guard that is not is a gap.

provider.description:
Who publishes the price, when the owner program alone does not say
(e.g. "Edge by Chaos Labs" on a Doves account).

underlying.description:
The feeds a protocol-run aggregator combines for this market, where
the registry says how to read them (edge case 11).

underlying_markets.description:
The same, per further market reading this account (Kamino: every
reserve of the market), keyed by market name (F4).

OracleSource.description: Who publishes the price, from the oracle account's owner program (COL-12).

oneOf.description: A feed run by the protocol itself or by a single signer.
An owner program `oracles.yaml` does not know.

loader.description: Owner of the program account (COL-7); None when it was not read.

ProgramHistory.description:
A program's upgrade history as far as it has been read. Busy ProgramData
accounts appear in many unrelated transactions, so the history fills over
several runs within the daily call budget.

complete.description: True once every transaction has been examined.

scanned.description: Transactions on the account examined so far.

total.description: Transactions on the account found so far.

ProgramRole.description: `core` programs hold or move user funds and decide the Stage (REG-5).

admin.description: Admin keys outside upgrades, keyed by `<account>.<field>`.

admin_review.description:
A sourced registry review that found no admin accounts. Without it,
an empty `admin` map means "not yet read", never "none" (v0.3).

dependencies.description: Programs the core programs call with user funds.

last_reviewed.description: The registry entry's `last_reviewed` date, for the review-due note (REG-7).

min_slot.description: Lowest and highest slot among this protocol's reads (COL-3).

name.description: Display name and website from the registry.

oracle_review.description: A sourced registry review that found no price feeds (v0.3).

oracles.description: Price feeds, keyed by oracle account.

reviewed_by.description: Who last reviewed the registry entry.

sources.description:
Where each registry address was confirmed, sorted by kind then
address (shown on the protocol page, UI-12).

tokens.description: Tokens the protocol uses and how, from the registry (TOK-2); keyed by mint.

ProtocolMetrics.description: One protocol's context metrics for the day.

volume.description: Daily volume, DEXs only; others show fees only (VAL-6).

admin.description:
Each admin field's own rating, keyed like the facts' `admin` map; the
Admin powers factor is their weakest link (UI-21).

callees.description: Each sampled callee's upgrade-control rating (UI-12, UI-21).

control_class.description: The class of the weakest core program's controller (VAL-2).

controller_summary.description: That controller in a few words, for tables.

programs.description: Every program, core and periphery, with its own ratings.

risks.description: L2Beat-style risk sentences, most severe first (SCO-9).

tokens.description: Tokens the protocol uses, with their worst rating (TOK-7).

Rating.description:
A factor rating. `Unknown` (missing data, SCO-7) and `NotApplicable` are
shown separately from High; neither is a risk level.

RegistrySource.description: A registry address and the public page that confirms it (REG-3).

label.description: Program name, admin field or oracle market.

Requirement.description: One Stage requirement and whether this protocol meets it.

detail.description: Why it is or is not met, naming programs and values.

awaiting_human_review.description:
True while no human has reviewed the entry: the registry names a
draft reviewer or none (H2).

due.description: True when the review is older than 90 days, or has no date.

ReviewedNone.description:
A registry statement that a protocol has none of something (admin
accounts, price feeds), with the public page that shows it.

note.description: What was checked, in one sentence.

source.description: The source or documentation the review relied on.

Severity.description: Follows the rating that produced the sentence. Low produces none.

missing.description: Unmet requirements of `next`, as L2Beat's "items missing for Stage N".

next.description: The next Stage up, if any.

requirements.description: Every requirement of every Stage, met or not.

warning.description: Set when the protocol accepts a High-rated token as collateral.

worst.description: The token's weakest factor rating; Unknown if it was not scored.

TokenRole.description: How a protocol uses a token (TOK-2).

address.description:
The address the aggregator maps the entry to: an oracle or pool
account, or a feed ID for push-based sources.

source_type.description:
The aggregator's own name for the source type (Scope: `Chainlink`,
`PythLazer`, `OrcaWhirlpoolAtoB`, …), from its vendored IDL.

UnderlyingFeeds.description: What an aggregator (Kamino Scope) reads for one market.

oneOf.description: Leaf sources, sorted by type then address.

UpgradeEvent.description: One change to a program's ProgramData account (VAL-4).

date.description:
`YYYY-MM-DD` from the block time; None when the chain has no block
time for the slot (show the slot only, never a guessed date).

oneOf.description: The authority was removed: the program became immutable.

average_interval_days.description: Mean days between consecutive dated upgrades, one decimal.

complete.description:
True when every history was read in full; otherwise the counts are a
lower bound.

upgrades.description: Upgrades across the protocol's core programs (deploys excluded).

upgrades_last_30_days.description: Dated upgrades in the 30 days up to and including `as_of`.

$schema.description: Root-relative path of this file's JSON Schema.

facts.description: A registry reviewer naming a draft is withheld (H2).

history.description: One entry per snapshot, oldest first.

program_history.description: Upgrade history of this protocol's programs, keyed by program.

snapshot_date.description: The snapshot these data come from (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
